news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹93.31 (vs ₹105 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹93.31 (down from ₹105 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹85.3b (up 15% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹9.03b (down 11% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 11% (down from 14% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 8.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Construction industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 11% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 4% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 0.1% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). news.title: G R Infraprojects Limited Announces Resignation of Sibanarayan Nayak as President - Corporate Affairs and Development, Effective December 31, 2025
news.body: G R Infraprojects Limited announced that Mr. Sibanarayan Nayak, President- Corporate Affairs and Development, Senior Managerial Personnel (SMP) of the Company, has tendered his resignation via email dated November 2, 2025. The resignation of Mr. Nayak has been accepted, and the effective date of his resignation was December 31, 2025. Mr. Sibanarayan Nayak cited the reason for his resignation as 'To move toward a more relaxed work life, along with pursuing certain social and developmental engagements close to my heart.'
